headline: Reliance Industries Hosts U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio at Jamnagar
summary: Reliance Industries Chairman Mukesh Ambani hosted U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio at the Jamnagar refinery to spotlight energy ties and trade cooperation.
why: Meetings between top government officials and major energy conglomerates highlight geopolitical trade alignments and foreign investment opportunities in critical markets.
